_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_probate_court.label: County Probate Court
county_probate_court.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

docket_number.label: Docket Number
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

plaintiff.label: Plaintiff
plaintiff.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

defendant.label: Defendant
defendant.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

name_of_removing_party.label: Name Of Removing Party
name_of_removing_party.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

removal_basis.label: Removal Basis
removal_basis.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

county_for_order.label: County For Order
county_for_order.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

date.label: Date
date.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

removing_party_or_attorney.label: Removing Party Or Attorney
removing_party_or_attorney.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

attorney_details.label: Attorney Details
attorney_details.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

fees_received_amount.label: Fees Received Amount
fees_received_amount.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

forwarded_date.label: Forwarded Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields
